description: Ranged weapons normally attack during the Assault Phase.

weapons.name: Javelins
weapons.notes: Purchasing Javelins grants both the Assault profile and the Combat profile above. Their Point cost is counted only once.

categories.name: Bows
notes: Long Range increases the Longbow's maximum effective distance to 12", but Attacks beyond 9" worsen Hit by one step.

categories.name: Firearms
categories.note: All Firearms possess Instant in addition to their listed Keywords.
notes: Firearm identifies the Attack as a firearm for rules and Talent interactions. Firearm Attacks remain Physical unless another rule grants Magic.
Instant prevents the Attack from being responded to with Command Abilities.
Rapid-Fire 2 grants two additional Attack dice when the target is within half the weapon's normal Range.
Firearms generally have strong immediate effectiveness but are harder to improve through Talents that specifically benefit bows and other non-Firearm ranged weapons.

designNotes: v4 balance pass (post-playtesting): Damage-1 weapons gained +1 Attack; Damage-2/Heavy weapons (Heavy Bow, Heavy Crossbow, Musket) kept their listed Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] 1.

v5 balance pass (second damage-output pass): Damage-1 weapons gained a further +1 Attack; Damage-2/Heavy weapons (Heavy Bow, Heavy Crossbow, Musket) raised their Anti-[Type] to 2. The Handgun was removed as redundant with the Pistol, and the Pistol and Carbine were then trimmed by 1 Attack each.
